scope: 35 currently pending finished-product CTR legal-scope decisions; non-automated five-gate evidence workbench.

primary_source_findings.statement: The signed FSSAI notice invites stakeholder comments on Metals and Minerals manual before finalisation. It does not itself approve mandatory method adoption.
primary_source_findings.false_inference_to_block: Panel approval or PDF hosted on government site equals final enforceable manual.

primary_source_findings.statement: Seven FSSAI 09.001–09.007:2024 identifiers refer to different procedures across the 61-page and 52-page official-hosted PDFs.
primary_source_findings.false_inference_to_block: Method number alone unambiguously identifies analyte, digestion, instrument, or regulated matrix.

primary_source_findings.statement: The official FSSAI manuals index includes a generic 'Manual on Metals' in the manuals section and separately lists mandatory-adoption orders; visible listing does not by itself settle which of these 2024 PDFs is current.
primary_source_findings.false_inference_to_block: An index section or an unlinked source file proves the 2024 consultation attachment has been finalised.

primary_source_findings.statement: No explicit finalisation/supersession/adoption instrument resolving these two 2024 files was directly established by this review. This is an unresolved search result, not proof no such order exists.
primary_source_findings.false_inference_to_block: No order was found means no order exists or the draft can never be adopted.

primary_source_findings.statement: The 61-page manual explicitly places responsibility on the testing laboratory to verify methods in its own laboratory; this note does not demonstrate a particular lab's instrument, matrix, LOQ or accreditation scope.
primary_source_findings.false_inference_to_block: Published FSSAI method or approximate capability establishes one laboratory's validated LOQ or PASS.

method_authority_status.note: Verified publication as June 2024 consultation does not prove the draft remained draft forever. No methods are endorsed until the applicable adoption/current PDF is established.

gate_definitions.label: Exact marketed product form
gate_definitions.basis: Obtain signed formulation/market label, actual product category and processed, fat, moisture, wet/dry/reconstitution basis of the commercial sample.

gate_definitions.label: Current legal article and chemical
gate_definitions.basis: Apply currently effective original CTR and amendments to the exact sold finished article and named analyte, without transferring comparator product rows.

gate_definitions.label: Matrix-validated laboratory assay
gate_definitions.basis: Confirm named method title and original PDF, method version, test analyte, sample matrix, accredited scope, batch blanks/recovery and LOQ below an independently signed applicable legal threshold.
